### The Faces of Evil
Author: Stuart Briscoe
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/one-year-devotions-for-men/the-faces-of-evil-one-year-devotions-for-men-november-4.html
Passage: Ezra 6:14
Points:
- Evil assumes many forms, ranging from seductive cooperation to outright intimidation, but always seeks to halt God's work.
- The rebuilders rightly declined deceptive offers of assistance to protect the purity of worship.
- Preaching from the prophets Haggai and Zechariah revived and propelled the work when it stalled.
- God sovereignly worked through civic order, keeping governor Tattenai within legal bounds to allow the project to continue.
- Discerning believers must see past deceptive facades and seek godly counsel to identify evil clearly.

### Bible Pathway - June 3
Author: Bible Pathway Ministries
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/biblepathways/bible-pathway-june-3-2013.html
Passage: Ezra 6:14
Points:
- Believers are called to persevere through hardships and finish the work God has set before them.
- The temple project overcame severe challenges under three different foreign monarchs because God moved their hearts.
- God frequently works through unexpected and seemingly unworthy people to fulfill His divine purposes.
- Human standing before God does not rest on good works, but on His choosing and gracious calling.
- Knowing that God Himself appointed the work should inspire believers to carry it through to completion.
